newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Four icebreakers near St Petersburg.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Four icebreakers near St Petersburg.

text.p: New ice gathered around Riga and below 58 degrees north, and four icebreakers were now on station near St Petersburg and Vyborg, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said on Thursday.

In its twice-weekly report, the institute specified new restrictions to navigation in the north of the Gulf of Bothnia, allowing only ice classes IA with minimum deadweights of 2000 tonnes to Oulu, Kemi and Tornio and classes IA and IB with minimum deadweights of 2000 tonnes to Raahe from January 3.
Three icebreakers were on station in the extreme north of the Gulf of Bothnia near Oulu, Kemi and Lulea and one north of Ornskoldsvik in the middle of the Gulf of Bothnia, it said.
